mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_REQUEST (FROM_USER, TO_USER, STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{fromUser}, #{toUser}, 'PENDING', NOW())
INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM (USER_A, USER_B, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userA}, #{userB}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM CHAT_ROOM WHERE (USER_A = #{userId} AND USER_B = #{otherId}) OR (USER_A = #{otherId} AND USER_B = #{userId}) LIMIT 1

SELECT R.ROOM_ID, CASE WHEN R.USER_A = #{userId} THEN R.USER_B ELSE R.USER_A END AS OTHER_ID, U.NICKNAME AS OTHER_NICK, U.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS OTHER_IMG, (SELECT M.CONTENT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1) AS LAST_MSG, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND M.SENDER_ID != #{userId} AND M.IS_READ = 'N') AS UNREAD_COUNT, (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(M.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1) AS LAST_AT FROM CHAT_ROOM R JOIN USER U ON U.USER_ID = CASE WHEN R.USER_A = #{userId} THEN R.USER_B ELSE R.USER_A END
WHERE (R.USER_A = #{userId} OR R.USER_B = #{userId}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHAT_ROOM_HIDE H WHERE H.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND H.USER_ID = #{userId} )
ORDER BY LAST_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE (ROOM_ID, SENDER_ID, CONTENT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT M.MESSAGE_ID, M.ROOM_ID, M.SENDER_ID,
CASE WHEN M.IS_DELETED = 'Y' THEN '삭제된 메시지입니다' ELSE M.CONTENT END AS CONTENT,
CASE WHEN M.IS_DELETED = 'Y' THEN 'TEXT' ELSE M.MESSAGE_TYPE END AS MESSAGE_TYPE,
M.IS_READ, M.IS_DELETED,
DATE_FORMAT(M.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATED_AT, U.NICKNAME AS SENDER_NICK, U.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS SENDER_IMG
FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M JOIN USER U ON U.USER_ID = M.SENDER_ID
WHERE M.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHAT_MESSAGE_HIDE H WHERE H.MESSAGE_ID = M.MESSAGE_ID AND H.USER_ID = #{userId} )
ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT ASC
